content.title: Dekode Base64 ke Gambar
content.p1: Menemukan rangkaian panjang karakter acak yang dimulai dengan data:image/... dan tidak tahu apa itu? Kemungkinan itu adalah gambar yang dikodekan Base64.

faq.title: Pertanyaan yang Sering Diajukan
faq.q1: How does the Base64 to Image converter work?
faq.a1: This tool takes a Base64 encoded string as input and decodes it back into its original binary image format. It parses the data URI scheme (e.g., data:image/png;base64,...) to identify the image type and content.
faq.q2: What image formats can I decode?
faq.a2: The tool supports all common web image formats including PNG, JPG (JPEG), GIF, WEBP, BMP, and SVG, provided the Base64 string contains the correct MIME type header.
faq.q3: Is this tool free to use?
faq.a3: Yes, our Base64 to Image decoder is 100% free to use with no limits on the number of conversions.
faq.a4: Yes. The decoding process runs client-side in your browser for preview. We do not store or save your images on our servers.
faq.q5: What if my Base64 string is invalid?
faq.a5: If the string is corrupted or incomplete, the tool will display an error message. Ensure you have copied the entire string, including the identifying header part.
